text:
Nora Fields: Hey team, day 1 as Product Designer — quick access Qs: I accepted the org invite but can't open "Design Roadmap - Team" in Figma (Request access). Also where are the PRD templates and research consent templates?

Omar Ruiz: welcome Nora!! :wave: I just re-provisioned you to the Designers group. Figma sometimes picks up personal Google accounts — try signing out and signing in via Okta/SSO.

Camille (design-ops-bot): Nora Fields has been added to groups: Designers, Product-Prototypes, Design-System-Readers.

Nora Fields: Still seeing Request access after SSO login. Screenshot attached.

Priya Shah: if that happens, try this sequence:
1) Open an incognito/private window
2) Sign in via Okta/SSO
3) Open the file link (not the email preview)
If it persists, post the email you used and I'll add you manually.

Evan Morales: I manage research ops. Consent templates + payment flow live in Notion > Research > Templates & Ops. We use Stripe Connect for payouts and prepaid gift cards for ad-hoc recruits. Always submit a Payment Request on the Research Ops page first.

Nora Fields: Thanks, email is nora.fields@redwood.com. Also where is the dev handoff checklist? Want to follow proper export naming.

Priya Shah: Added you manually to the Design Roadmap file. Handoff checklist: Notion > Design > Handoff (there's also a Figma frame called "Handoff Checklist" in the Design System file). Quick: tokens matched, export slices named, interaction notes in dev-mode.

Camille (design-ops-bot): Nora Fields added to "Design Roadmap - Team" and "Design System" files.

Evan Morales: For shadowing, we run Research Observers on Tues 9am and Thurs 2pm. New designers usually join the first session. I'll add you to Lookback and the calendar.

Nora Fields: Tue 9am works for me. Appreciate the speedy help, excited to get started!
